item.title: 2027: How we’ll resist rigging – Peter Obi reveals
item.description: Former presidential candidate Peter Obi has vowed that any attempt to rig the 2027 election will be resisted lawfully and legitimately. item.title: Gunmen abduct former Ogun lawmaker
item.description: Gunmen have abducted Maruf Musa, a former member of the Ogun state house of assembly. Musa, who represented Ogun Waterside constituency during the sixth assembly (2007-2011), was reportedly kidnapped on Tuesday night in Ibiade, Ogun Waterside LGA of the state. The assailants were said to have fired shots to disperse residents before abducting the former legislator during prayers at a mosque in his compound. item.title: ‘Significant moment in Nigeria’s history’ – Atiku welcomes Peter Obi to ADC
item.description: Former Vice President, Atiku Abubakar has reacted to the defection of Mr Peter Obi into the African Democratic Congress, ADC.
